Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: There were a lot more mandatory exercises to do troughout the semester, but it was in general not more difficult than KU

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: There is a lot more focus on active participation and you have to speak way more in class

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
APG5199 - Peacekeeping in the international system: Theory, policy and practice 
APG5045 - Gender and development 
APG5140 - Principles and practices for disaster management, humanitarian action and climate change adaptation
APG5367 - Campaigns, advocacy and change

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
I would recommend APG5199 - Peacekeeping in the international system: Theory, policy and practice and APG5367 - Campaigns, advocacy and change. 
The professors were very engaging and they made the courses really interesting

The surf club
It is really fun and a great way to meet local students

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: I would recommend going out in the nature. There is so much amazing wildlife outside the cities

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Very easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Australians are very friendly. You just have to initiate the first conversation

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: I didn't really find anything challenging when it comes to cultural differences

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: That australians are so friendly

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: I would just recommend going - it is an amazing experience that you don't want to miss

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Australia is a very expensive destination, so I would just recommend saving up money especially if you want to travel around

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Getting so many international friends

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Maybe just speaking english with native speakers, but that quickly becomes easier
